answer: The trellis ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own ridge record, and its own share of the fable quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 2391 identities would post 4090 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
